<p>As I carried out my duties as Vice Association President, the work had become familiar, and with no major incidents, I wasn’t particularly busy.</p><p>Time passed like that, and finally, Seong Yu-na’s due date was approaching.</p><p>I hadn’t realized how quickly time was passing.</p><p>It had been decided that the birth would take place at Echo’s castle, and Yu-na had been staying there for the past month before delivery.</p><p>Instead of going home after work each day, I headed straight to Echo’s castle.</p><p>I’d been worried she might be struggling, but to my surprise, she seemed perfectly at ease.</p><p>When I asked Nerus about it, he explained that among the empire’s many races, there were species that carried and gave birth to their young in a manner very similar to humans, so the human method wasn’t particularly surprising to them.</p><p>With spells from Lev and Yuria to ease her pain and help her move comfortably, Yu-na was spending her days in peace.</p><p>Then, when she started having contractions, I received word that the birth was imminent and rushed to Echo’s castle at once.</p><p>“Your Majesty! Yu-na—she’s—right now!”</p><p>“Don’t panic and wait in the room. It will be much faster and far less painful than the human way.”</p><p>“Y-yes…”</p><p>Nerus patted my shoulder, and I followed him into the room.</p><p>I was told that Yoon Na-hyeon and Yoon Ji-hyeon would arrive soon.</p><p>Nerus seemed to be trying to put me at ease, as he brought up various topics of conversation.</p><p>“Lord Seong-hyeon… I don’t mean to dismiss human medical technology, but our magic is far more advanced and effective than what humans call medicine. You needn’t worry.”</p><p>“Thank you…”</p><p>But even with Nerus’s reassurance, my pounding heart and restless mind refused to settle. For hours, I paced alone around the room.</p><p>“Seong-hyeon!”</p><p>“Oppa!”</p><p>It was only when Na-hyeon and Ji-hyeon arrived that my anxiety eased slightly. The three of us held hands and waited inside the room for news.</p><p>About four hours later, Yuria knocked and opened the door.</p><p>Creak</p><p>“Yuria! How is Yu-na?”</p><p>Yuria smiled brightly as she replied,</p><p>“Both the countess and the young master are safe. They’re resting now, so why don’t you go see them?”</p><p>“Yes!”</p><p>I immediately rushed to Yu-na’s room with Na-hyeon and Ji-hyeon.</p><p>Creak</p><p>“Yu-na!”</p><p>“You’re being loud. You’ll wake the baby.”</p><p>“Honey…”</p><p>Yu-na welcomed me with a bright smile, cradling the baby in her arms.</p><p>“Hold him. Isn’t he your heir? A sturdy little boy.”</p><p>“Ah…”</p><p>Yu-na nodded and stretched her arms toward me, offering the child.</p><p>“Hah…”</p><p>My hands trembled.</p><p>I couldn’t believe this tiny, precious, lovable life was my own child. At the same time, I worried he was so small and fragile that my touch might hurt him.</p><p>“Honey, it’s okay.”</p><p>“Ah, yeah…”</p><p>I took the baby into my arms.</p><p>When I realized this little life was the fruit of Yu-na’s and my love, tears began to flow.</p><p>I’d thought I’d be overjoyed holding my child, but strangely, my eyes wouldn’t stop crying.</p><p>“Oh dear… Honey, you’re crying again.”</p><p>“Seong-hyeon.”</p><p>“Oppa.”</p><p>“…”</p><p>Still, the tears kept falling.</p><p>Could such an angelic being really grow up in the hands of someone like me?</p><p>Could I raise this child the right way?</p><p>Did someone like me—who had stained his hands with the blood of countless humans and monsters—even deserve this happiness?</p><p>As I cried, my tears a mix of joy and worry, Ji-hyeon and Na-hyeon hugged me.</p><p>“Oppa, you’ll do great.”</p><p>“Seong-hyeon, you can do anything. You always have, and you always will.”</p><p>Yu-na reached out her hand, and I took it.</p><p>“My love, you’re always so reliable.”</p><p>“Thanks.”</p><p>As we all hugged with the baby between us, Echo cut in.</p><p>“Now, we should give him a name.”</p><p>“Huh? Oh, yes. Your Majesty.”</p><p>Echo took the baby into his arms and smiled.</p><p>“Very well. This child’s name shall be ‘Lion.’”</p><p>“What?!”</p><p>What was happening?</p><p>I glanced at Yu-na, but she just shook her head helplessly.</p><p>I wasn’t the superstitious type, but now that I had a child, I understood how parents felt.</p><p>That was why I’d already spent a fortune visiting renowned naming specialists and had five potential names picked out.</p><p>I’d been planning to choose one of them, but then Echo had casually, as if it were the most natural thing in the world, named the child himself.</p><p>“Your Majesty?”</p><p>When I looked at Echo, she instead answered with an expression that said she didn’t understand my reaction.</p><p>“Why are you acting like this? Yu-na is my close friend, and this child is her daughter, so I am also this child’s godmother. Isn’t it only natural for a godmother or godfather to name their godchild?”</p><p>“Huh? Haah…”</p><p>It seemed that in Echo’s empire, such a culture existed.</p><p>The name itself wasn’t bad, but even if it were, there was nothing I could do about it.</p><p>I could only take comfort in the fact that the name Echo had chosen wasn’t common by Korean standards, but it wasn’t bad either.</p><p>“Your Majesty, may I ask if the name has any special meaning?”</p><p>“It’s the name of a valiant warrior who once guarded the empire. It’s much longer, but I shortened it to two syllables to respect my friend’s opinion.”</p><p>“Yes, thank you so much.”</p><p>I really was grateful.</p><p>If she had used the full name, it would’ve been absurdly long, like the names of medieval nobles.</p><p>***</p><p>After staying at Echo’s castle for about another week, I returned home.</p><p>Yu-na had started breastfeeding, and she spent all day taking care of Leon at home.</p><p>Maybe this was what a father’s heart felt like—ever since then, rushing home to see Leon as soon as I got off work had become my daily routine.</p><p>Even though I told Yu-na to rest since she still needed to recover, she wanted to hold Leon in her arms all day.</p><p>Perhaps because he inherited my blood, he seemed a little stronger than other babies his age.</p><p>And he was so mature that he rarely cried.</p><p>The whole family pitched in with childcare whenever they had free time.</p><p>That didn’t mean childcare was difficult, though.</p><p>At night, Lev and Yuria took care of Leon, so we could sleep peacefully.</p><p>Becoming a father had changed my mindset a lot.</p><p>Every morning when I woke up and went to work, my steps felt lighter, and my perspective on the world shifted from pessimistic to optimistic.</p><p>I wanted to work harder so that the world would be a little easier for my child to live in.</p><p>Of course, officially, Leon was registered as Yu-na’s child out of wedlock.</p><p>I was fine with that.</p><p>Hye-na knew that Leon was the child between Yu-na and me, but Yu-na, who saw Awakened and ordinary people as entirely different species, didn’t think much of it.</p><p>I had told my family the truth, and Hye-na had even come to the house to see Leon in person.</p><p>Though I had nearly had a heart attack when I walked in to find Echo sprawled on the sofa, lazily munching on potato chips.</p><p>And ever since Lion was born, that day has been coming for me too.</p><p>***</p><p>Chuuup chuup
